lines.t: Make the way straight, make it straight for his return
The earth trembles, the king is coming
Thus says the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand, the power to birth
In my left hand, judgment and flame I am he, the engine of days, the great I am
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob Whose name is Israel, none can shake him
I sent my only begotten, the world became flesh Yahushua, a man of El, righteousness and breath
He came once in mercy, comes again in power Every knee will bow, every nation will cower
The Holy One returns, the trumpet sounds The Lord of hosts is heaven bound
Make the way straight, make the way
He's pathed away, Yahushua, Hamashiach, the lion will roar
Call his name, be restored
Make the way straight, make the way
He's pathed away, Yahushua, Hamashiach, the lion will roar
Call his name, be restored
Make the way straight
Ahead came John, the voice in the wild
Crying out, repent, the spirit compiled
Pile, trumpet in hand, water and word
Baptized the broken, spoke what he heard
Now more than 4,000 rise in the land
Fire in their voices, trumpet in hand
Spirit of Elijah, thunder in their breath
Preparing the way, defying death
Witnesses walking with tongues aflame
Bearing his name, not seeking fame
Judgments fall, foundations quake
The pride of man, the Lord shall break
Cities fall, towers bend, desolation sweeps
Yet there's hope in the end, call upon Yahushua
Call and be saved, the Lamb who conquered the grave
Yet there's sanctuary in the storm
A way of escape has been formed
He is the Christ, Yahushua by name
Call upon him
Be free from shame
Make the waves tap, don't wait
Yahushua HaMashiach, the lion will roar
Call his name, be restored
Make the waves straight
Make the berries tap, don't wait
Yahushua HaMashiach, the lion will roar
Call his name, be restored
Don't make the way straight
Repent and rise, don't wait
Trumpets sound, hearts ignite
Yahushua reigns forever in light
Call upon Him
In truth, and you shall surely be delivered
Says the Lord
Thanks for watching!
